thread:
maya (PM): Quick sync on private deploy migration handshake + rollback paths. We have 3 customer asks: zero-downtime upgrade for DB schema, customer-managed network handoff w/ preflight, and clearer rollback SLAs. Need priorities & executable plan.

dan (eng): +1 on preflight tool. Propose a two-phase upgrade: control-plane roll then data-plane shift. That lets us validate API compatibility before DB migration.

ravi (infra): Two-phase makes sense. For on-prem, also need an agent that can do 'dry-run' network checks and report ports/firewall rules. I built a tiny script last week.

leila (solutions): Customers kept asking for a checklist they can run during maintenance windows. If we expose a CLI preflight we can add it to our support playbook.

maya (PM): Draft scope: 1) preflight CLI & returnable report 2) documented two-phase pattern + example manifests 3) rollback playbook w/ steps and time estimates 4) DB migration helper for common cases. Thoughts on MVP vs wishlist?

dan (eng): MVP = preflight CLI + two-phase docs + simple rollback doc. DB migration helper is more complex (data transformation edge cases). Move to wishlist unless customer committed $$.

ravi (infra): Agree. For preflight, here's a sample output we can standardize:
```
$ redwood-preflight --target vpc://customer
checks:
  - routing: OK
  - firewall: FAIL (port 50051 closed)
  - dns: OK
report_id: pf-2026-03-10-123
```

sam (security): Also add KMS key rotation check + HSM connectivity test. Those cause the most support escalations.

leila (solutions): For rollback SLAs we should define two tiers: safe rollback (config-only) => 15m, DB rollback => 2-6h depending on size. Customers expect concrete numbers.

maya (PM): Good call. I'll draft SLA table. Action items: dan -> proto preflight CLI by EOW, ravi -> package dry-run agent + sample manifests, leila -> runbook + customer-facing checklist, sam -> list security preflight checks. I'll post a lightweight RFC by Tue.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: redwood-preflight v0.1 -> staging at 2026-03-12T09:00Z

dan (eng): Quick Q: For on-prem, should preflight be agentless first (SSH) then agent? Agentless hits permission issues often.

ravi (infra): Start agentless for MVP, but include an agent mode for deeper checks. We'll make agent optional.

leila (solutions): I'll flag 2 customers who asked for DB helper as potential pilot if we get a small funding carveout.

maya (PM): Thanks all — will collate and sensibly pare scope. If anyone has a short example of a customer network failure we should include, drop it here.

leila (solutions): Dropped an example in #support-logs: customer A had NAT gateway blocking gRPC; preflight would've caught it.

maya (PM): perfect. End of thread.
